items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: actually my first roommate was Warren Hargut, who was from Music and Art.

ctx.x: He said that, he said that. I’ll never forget. Because he felt it would make a difference. Because here I am in the big city of Harlem — not a big city of Harlem — big city of New York, and I’m going to essentially a country town. You know I’ll never forget because downtown Fredonia reminded me of a scene from “In the Heat of the Night.” You know, just the opening scene of “In the Heat of the Night.” You’d go downtown, if you ever see it, it looks like downtown Fredonia. Okay? So anyway but at that point that was…
